scientific_integrity: Claim is accompanied by a self-contained all-length proof and reproducible finite direct tests; finite calculations are not treated as proof. Public presentation date verified in the ISIT 2021 technical program (July 19, 2021); independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary fixed Hamming weight two; exactly one contiguous two-position deletion; does not cover multiple bursts, variable burst length, larger weights, complete optimizer classification, or decoder runtime. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Exact capacity of binary weight-two codes correcting two consecutive deletions
